text: A psalm of David. I I sing of mercy and justice;to you, Lord, I sing praise.
I study the way of integrity; [AA]when will you come to me?I act with integrity of heartwithin my household. [1] [AB]
I do not allow into my presence anything base.I hate wrongdoing;I will have no part of it. [AC]
May the devious heart keep far from me;the wicked I will not acknowledge.
Whoever slanders a neighbor in secretI will reduce to silence. [AD]Haughty eyes and arrogant hearts [AE]I cannot endure.
II I look to the faithful of the land [2]to sit at my side.Whoever follows the way of integrity [AF]is the one to enter my service.
No one who practices deceitcan remain within my house.No one who speaks falselycan last in my presence. [AG]
t[3]Morning after morning I clear all the wicked from the land,to rid the city of the Lord of all doers of evil.
